Extracts a Canny edge map from one supplied photo, then generates a new image under that edge structure using DiffSynth-Studio's Qwen-Image Blockwise Canny ControlNet — a model-patch mechanism rather than a classic ControlNet, baked directly into the diffusion model instead of conditioning it externally.

Extracts a relative depth map from one supplied photo with Depth Anything V2, then generates a new image under that spatial structure using DiffSynth-Studio's Qwen-Image Blockwise Depth ControlNet — a model-patch mechanism rather than a classic ControlNet, baked directly into the diffusion model instead of conditioning it externally.

Inpaints the masked region of one supplied image using DiffSynth-Studio's Qwen-Image Blockwise Inpaint ControlNet — a model-patch mechanism rather than a classic ControlNet. The masked region comes from the uploaded image's own alpha channel; the generated result is composited back over the original so every unmasked pixel is preserved.

displayName: Qwen Image — generate from a photo's depth
description: Extracts a relative depth map from one supplied photo with Depth Anything V2, then generates a new image under that spatial structure using Qwen Image + InstantX Union ControlNet. Uses the photo as a depth/composition source only, not as an identity or style reference.

displayName: Qwen Image — generate from a photo's edges
description: Extracts a high-contrast Canny edge map from one supplied photo, then generates a new image under that edge structure using Qwen Image + InstantX Union ControlNet. Uses the photo as an edge/composition source only, not as an identity or style reference.

displayName: Qwen Image — generate from a photo's lineart
description: Extracts clean contour lineart from one supplied photo, then generates a new image under that contour structure using Qwen Image + InstantX Union ControlNet. Uses the photo as a structural source only, not as an identity or style reference.

displayName: Qwen Image — generate from a photo's pose
description: Extracts the body, hands, and face pose from one supplied image with DWPose, then generates a new image under that pose using Qwen Image + InstantX Union ControlNet. This uses the photo as a pose source only, not as an identity or style reference.

displayName: Qwen Image — generate from a photo's surface normals
description: Extracts a surface-normal map from one supplied photo using BAE, then generates a new image under that surface structure using Qwen Image + InstantX Union ControlNet. Uses the photo as a structural source only, not as an identity or style reference.

Generates an image under strong control of one supplied guide image using Qwen Image and InstantX Union ControlNet. Use a prepared control image such as a depth map, Canny edge map, or another Union-compatible guide; it is not an image-reference/edit workflow.

Generates an image under strong structural control from one supplied guide image using Qwen Image and Alibaba PAI's Fun-Controlnet-Union (2512/2602). Broader control-type coverage than the InstantX Union ControlNet: canny, HED/soft-edge, depth, pose, MLSD, and scribble guides, plus its own inpainting mode. Use a prepared control image such as a depth map, Canny edge map, pose skeleton, or line-drawing guide; it is not an image-reference/edit workflow.

Inpaints part of one reference image per the prompt using Qwen-Image with the InstantX inpainting ControlNet. The masked region comes from the uploaded image's own alpha channel — the app encodes the painted area as transparency before upload.
Uses image 1 as the character reference and image 2 as a prepared pose guide. The supplied Qwen graph has no DWPose preprocessor, so extraction remains an explicit separate workflow.
Uses image 1 as the character reference and image 2 as an already-prepared DWPose/OpenPose guide. Unlike the photo-pose variant, image 2 is passed directly and is not preprocessed again.

Combines two reference images per the prompt (e.g. transferring a material or attribute from one image onto the other) using Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, with an optional (disabled by default) 4-step LoRA toggle baked into the graph.

Uses image 1 as the inpaint base and image 2 as a reference. Select a private mask for image 1: the app encodes its painted area as transparency for ComfyUI, the workflow edits that region, then composites the result back over the original to preserve every unmasked pixel.
Edits one reference image per the prompt using Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, with an optional (disabled by default) 4-step LoRA toggle baked into the graph.
Combines three reference images per the prompt using Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (the documented sweet-spot ceiling), with an optional (disabled by default) 4-step LoRA toggle baked into the graph.

Removes the background from one supplied image, producing a transparent-background cutout of the main subject using the general-purpose isnet-general-use model. Deterministic single-image tool: no prompt, no generation model, not a creative edit.

Official SD 3.5 Large Canny ControlNet template converted for the Comfy API. Derives edges from one reference image to guide composition.
